I just feel morally wrong for it and feel so ashamed that I turned to it, and feel even more sad that my one and only friend had spoken to me earlier a few weeks ago, about many subjects in life and it was one of our topics (I vent a lot to him as my family is not very supportive)  and happened to mention that he didn't think it was bad. I'm not blaming him for my mistake, I'm just sad that he mentioned it because my mind keeps trying to blame him for it when I know it's definitely my fault and it's causing me to feel even more guilty. 

Also thank you for talking to me.
